name: NIST AI RMF
fullName: Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0), NIST AI 100-1
publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)
appliesTo: Voluntary framework for any organization designing, developing, deploying or using AI systems.
note: Mapped at category level only; each category has subcategories whose full intent is broader than the common controls shown.

requirements.title: AI risk policies, processes and practices in place and effective
Accountability structures empower and train teams on AI risk
Workforce diversity, equity, inclusion and accessibility prioritized in AI risk
Organizational culture considers and communicates AI risk
Processes for robust engagement with relevant AI actors
Policies address third-party software, data and supply chain AI risks
Categorization of the AI system is performed
AI capabilities, usage, goals, benefits and costs understood
Risks and benefits mapped for all components incl. third parties
Impacts to individuals, groups, communities and society characterized
Appropriate methods and metrics identified and applied
AI systems evaluated for trustworthy characteristics
Mechanisms track identified AI risks over time
Feedback about measurement efficacy gathered and assessed
AI risks prioritized, responded to and managed
Strategies maximize AI benefits and minimize negative impacts
AI risks and benefits from third-party entities managed
Risk treatments, response, recovery and communication plans monitored
